signals.source_text: Pazuzu and Torhh stood where the ritual had occurred, the valley still scarred by convergence forces that had reshaped terrain at fundamental levels.

The Tidecaller looked toward the ocean where Brajor allies had died despite their choice to resist programming, toward the mountains where Ash Giants were accepting Anunnaki healing treatments, providing intelligence on other tribal movements, allowing Needle infrastructure to be maintained through their territories without resistance.
